sketchMechanisms: Optional chaining — accessing a property through a chain of optionals silently returns nil if any link is missing, and the ? operator makes absence grammatically visible
The `nothing` bottom type — a function declared to return Nothing can never return normally; it must throw or loop forever, making irrecoverable finality a type-level guarantee
Weak references — weakref allows you to hold a reference to an object that does not prevent it from being garbage collected; accessing it after collection returns None
